title: "Using set -x Wisely"

# Using set -x Wisely

Wrap suspicious code sections selectively:

```bash
set -x # Enable tracing
risky_function "$param"
set +x # Disable tracing
```

Customize trace prefix for debugging source files and line numbers:

```bash
export PS4='+ ${BASH_SOURCE}:${LINENO}: ${FUNCNAME[0]:+${FUNCNAME[0]}(): }'
```
